text:
maya: Quick kickoff for the OSS Inference Toolkit (refapp + tutorial + benchmark). Target launch: Fri Mar 12 (two weeks). Goal: blog post + GitHub release + tutorial video + reproducible benchmark + webinar. Who owns what?

sam: Love it. For the benchmark post we should surface p95 latency, tokens/sec, and cost per 1k tokens vs our baseline. Need the exact config + reproducible script.

lina: Webinar suggestion: 30 min demo (walk through refapp + local dev flow) + 20 min live Q&A. Record and clip 3x 30s highlights for socials. Recommend partner guest if we can secure one.

ben: DevRel will own the GitHub release and starter template. I'll draft README + example CLI. Quick CLI snippet for the README: 

```bash
# bootstrap refapp
redwood-refapp create my-infer-app --model redwood/llama-3-8k
cd my-infer-app
redwood-refapp serve --port 8080
```

ben: Also prepping a "run locally" notebook and a lightweight benchmark script that matches Sam's requirements.

olivia: Inbound lead routing: use Google Form with hidden utm params, send to /webhooks/hubspot, tag leads with "oss-toolkit". Growth will triage and assign to AE queue. Also create Intercom label `oss-toolkit` for community questions.

maya: Action check — @ben can you have README + demo draft by Wed EOD? @olivia can you confirm HubSpot webhook + sample payload by Thu?

ben: Yep — README + demo draft by Wed EOD. :thumbsup:

olivia: Confirmed. I'll share the webhook spec and sample payload by Thu morning. :white_check_mark:

content-bot: Reminder: marketing needs final hero image and 2 screenshots by Thu for blog + GitHub. Use 1200x630 for social preview.

lina: I'll own the hero image and screenshots. Will drop assets in #marketing-assets by Thu noon.

maya: Also need a 60s demo clip and a short tweet thread. @ben can you produce the 60s demo?

ben: On it — will export MP4 and upload to #marketing-assets.

sam: For the benchmark reproducibility, publish this command in the blog: 

```bash
python run_bench.py --model redwood/llama-3-8k --seq 1024 --batch 8 --iters 200
```

maya: Final owner list for release:
- Blog post & benchmark narrative: sam
- GitHub release + README + starter template: ben
- Webinar logistics & recording: lina
- Inbound routing + HubSpot workflow: olivia
- Social copy + hero assets: maya + lina

maya: Thanks everyone — next sync is Friday 10am. :calendar:
